112: 	/**
113: 	 * Instantiates a {@link FileImageSink} with the file to which the thumbnail
114: 	 * should be written to.
115: 	 * <p>
116: 	 * The output format to use will be determined from the file extension.
117: 	 * If another format should be used, then the
118: 	 * {@link #setOutputFormatName(String)} should be called with the desired
119: 	 * output format name.
120: 	 * 
121: 	 * @param destinationFile		The destination file.
122: 	 * @param allowOverwrite		Whether or not the {@code FileImageSink}
123: 	 * 								should overwrite the destination file if
124: 	 * 								it already exists.
125: 	 * @throws NullPointerException	If the specified file is {@code null}.
126: 	 */
127: 	public FileImageSink(File destinationFile, boolean allowOverwrite) {
128: 		super();
129: 		
130: 		if (destinationFile == null) {
131: 			throw new NullPointerException("File cannot be null.");
132: 		}
133: 		
134: 		this.destinationFile = destinationFile;
135: 		this.outputFormat = getExtension(destinationFile);
136: 		this.allowOverwrite = allowOverwrite;
137: 	}
138: 	
139: 	/**
140: 	 * Instantiates a {@link FileImageSink} with the file to which the thumbnail
141: 	 * should be written to.
142: 	 * <p>
143: 	 * The output format to use will be determined from the file extension.
144: 	 * If another format should be used, then the
145: 	 * {@link #setOutputFormatName(String)} should be called with the desired
146: 	 * output format name.
147: 	 * <p>
148: 	 * When the destination file exists, then this {@code FileImageSink} will
149: 	 * overwrite the existing file.
150: 	 * 
151: 	 * @param destinationFilePath	The destination file path.
152: 	 * @throws NullPointerException	If the specified file path is {@code null}.
153: 	 */
154: 	public FileImageSink(String destinationFilePath) {
155: 		this(destinationFilePath, true);
156: 	}
157: 	
158: 	/**
159: 	 * Instantiates a {@link FileImageSink} with the file to which the thumbnail
160: 	 * should be written to.
161: 	 * <p>
162: 	 * The output format to use will be determined from the file extension.
163: 	 * If another format should be used, then the
164: 	 * {@link #setOutputFormatName(String)} should be called with the desired
165: 	 * output format name.
166: 	 * 
167: 	 * @param destinationFilePath	The destination file path.
168: 	 * @param allowOverwrite		Whether or not the {@code FileImageSink}
169: 	 * 								should overwrite the destination file if
170: 	 * 								it already exists.
171: 	 * @throws NullPointerException	If the specified file path is {@code null}.
172: 	 */
173: 	public FileImageSink(String destinationFilePath, boolean allowOverwrite) {
174: 		super();
175: 		
176: 		if (destinationFilePath == null) {
177: 			throw new NullPointerException("File cannot be null.");
178: 		}
179: 		
180: 		this.destinationFile = new File(destinationFilePath);
181: 		this.outputFormat = getExtension(destinationFile);
182: 		this.allowOverwrite = allowOverwrite;
183: 	}
184: 	
185: 	/**
186: 	 * Determines whether an specified format name and file extension are
187: 	 * for the same format.
188: 	 * 
189: 	 * @param formatName			Format name.
190: 	 * @param fileExtension			File extension.
191: 	 * @return						Returns {@code true} if the specified file
192: 	 * 								extension is valid for the specified format.
193: 	 */
194: 	private static boolean isMatchingFormat(String formatName, String fileExtension) throws UnsupportedFormatException {
195: 		if (formatName == null || fileExtension == null) {
196: 			return false;
197: 		}
198: 		
199: 		ImageWriter iw;
200: 		try {
201: 			iw = ImageIO.getImageWritersByFormatName(formatName).next();
202: 
203: 		} catch (NoSuchElementException e) {
204: 			throw new UnsupportedFormatException(
205: 					formatName,
206: 					"No suitable ImageWriter found for " + formatName + "."
207: 			);
208: 		}
209: 		
210: 		String[] suffixes = iw.getOriginatingProvider().getFileSuffixes();
211: 		
212: 		for (String suffix : suffixes) {
213: 			if (fileExtension.equalsIgnoreCase(suffix)) {
214: 				return true;
215: 			}
216: 		}
217: 		return false;
218: 	}
219: 	
220: 	/**
221: 	 * Returns the file extension of the given {@link File}.
222: 	 * 
223: 	 * @param f			The file.
224: 	 * @return			The extension of the file.
225: 	 */
226: 	private static String getExtension(File f) {
227: 		String fileName = f.getName();
228: 		if (
229: 				fileName.indexOf('.') != -1
230: 				&& fileName.lastIndexOf('.') != fileName.length() - 1
231: 		) {
232: 			int lastIndex = fileName.lastIndexOf('.');
233: 			return fileName.substring(lastIndex + 1);
234: 		}
235: 		
236: 		return null;
237: 	}
238: 	
239: 	public String preferredOutputFormatName() {
240: 		String fileExtension = getExtension(destinationFile);
241: 
242: 		if (fileExtension != null) {
243: 			Iterator<ImageReader> rIter = ImageIO.getImageReadersBySuffix(fileExtension);
244: 			
245: 			if (rIter.hasNext()) {
246: 				try {
247: 					return rIter.next().getFormatName();
248: 				} catch (IOException e) {
249: 					return ThumbnailParameter.ORIGINAL_FORMAT;
250: 				}
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 		
254: 		return outputFormat;
255: 	}
256: 	
257: 	/**
258: 	 * Writes the resulting image to a file.
259: 	 * 
260: 	 * @param img							The image to write.
261: 	 * @throws UnsupportedFormatException	When an unsupported format has been
262: 	 * 										specified by the
263: 	 * 										{@link #setOutputFormatName(String)}
264: 	 * 										method, or if the output format
265: 	 * 										has not been set and cannot be
266: 	 * 										determined from the file name.
267: 	 * @throws IOException					When a problem occurs while writing
